agendas.name: Coordinated Strike
agendas.description: Pre-game: select up to 3 T'AU EMPIRE units to be Guided. Each time a Guided unit destroys a Spotted enemy unit, the Guided unit gains 2XP.

agendas.name: Decisive Strike
agendas.description: During the first battle round, each T'AU EMPIRE unit that destroys an enemy unit in the Shooting phase gains 2XP.

agendas.name: For the Greater Good
agendas.description: Each time a Guided unit destroys a Spotted enemy unit while an Observer unit is within 6", the Observer unit gains 1XP.

agendas.name: Targeted Elimination
agendas.description: Pre-game: opponent selects one of their CHARACTER, MONSTER, or VEHICLE units as the target. If destroyed by a T'AU EMPIRE unit, the destroying unit gains 3XP.
